rv.q: A quartet of youthful vocalists welcome audiences back to storefront viewing with performances of unforced passion and interpretive virtuosity.
Jye Bryant’s musical is having its American premiere in this Chicago production at the newly named Pride Arts.
It may well be worth seeing this show for the great performances alone (especially Leigh's) despite its issues.
This modest, intelligent, quirky little chamber piece is a dramatic song cycle for four people who share their experiences with, and their feelings for, the title character.
Everything came together to create a wonderful experience with live theatre.

cn.t: This Australian chamber musical earns praise for its exploration of truth and lies, with critics highlighting strong performances and the compelling 75-minute one-act structure that reveals secrets through four characters.
